name: Standard circulation coin
definition: legal-tender coin struck for everyday circulation; a worn coin sold for its silver content (junk silver) is this kind with `metal_content` an attribute.
notes: Numista type tree lists Standard circulation coins

name: Circulating commemorative coin
definition: legal-tender coin with a commemorative design issued into circulation at face value.
notes: Numista lists Circulating commemorative coins

name: Non-circulating legal-tender coin
definition: legal-tender coin issued for collectors, not circulation, including any coin struck in proof, reverse proof or another collector finish or issued in a mint's presentation packaging, even in gold.
notes: Numista lists Non-circulating coins and Collector coins

name: Proof or mint set
definition: set of coins issued and sold by a mint as one packaged product (the only set kind, K-1, S3a).
notes: Provident Metals sells 1988 US Mint Proof Set; proof strikes never circulated

name: Emergency coin
definition: coin struck by an official authority in an emergency, such as a siege coin or official necessity coin.
notes: Numista Emergency coinage: siege coins, official necessity coins

name: Pattern or trial strike
definition: coin struck to test a design, die or metal and not issued for circulation.
notes: Numista lists Patterns as a coin type

name: Replica, fantasy or counterfeit coin
definition: copy of a coin, a coin-like piece of an issue that never existed, or a contemporary counterfeit made to pass as money.
notes: Numista lists Contemporary counterfeits, Coin replicas, Fantasy coins

name: Standard circulation note
definition: banknote issued by a currency authority for everyday circulation.
notes: Numista lists Standard circulation banknotes

name: Circulating commemorative note
definition: banknote with a commemorative design issued into circulation at face value.
notes: Numista lists Circulating commemorative banknotes

name: Non-circulating note
definition: legal-tender note issued for collectors and not put into circulation.
notes: Numista lists Non-circulating banknotes

name: Specimen, trial or pattern note
definition: note printed as a specimen, proof, trial or pattern, or prepared and never issued.
notes: Numista lists Non-issued banknotes and Banknote patterns and trials

name: Local or obsolete note
definition: note issued by a local or private bank, or of an issue that is no longer current, such as US obsolete currency and National Banknotes.
notes: Numista lists Local banknotes

name: Facsimile, fantasy or counterfeit note
definition: facsimile of a real note, a note of an issue that never existed, or a contemporary counterfeit.
notes: Numista lists Banknote replicas, Fantasy banknotes, Contemporary counterfeits

name: Prop or souvenir note
definition: note-like piece made as a film prop, demonstration note or souvenir and not legal tender (K-120).
notes: Numista lists Souvenir banknotes, Demonstration notes, Movie and theatre money

name: Bullion bar
definition: cast or minted bar of precious metal sold by metal content and weight.
notes: APMEX Gold Bars & Rounds category; bars from many refiners and mints

name: Bullion round
definition: coin-shaped piece of precious metal that is not legal tender, sold by metal content.
notes: APMEX sells 1 oz Silver Round Sunshine Mint; page contrasts rounds with coins having face value

name: Bullion coin
definition: legal-tender coin struck in a mint's bullion programme in the standard bullion finish.
notes: APMEX gold coins: American Gold Eagle, Maple Leaf, Krugerrand valued on gold content

name: Transit and toll token
definition: token issued to pay one fare or toll on a transit system, road or bridge.
notes: Numista Transportation tokens: public transportation, toll road tokens

name: Deposit token (locker or shopping cart)
definition: token issued to release a locker, shopping cart or similar deposit mechanism.
notes: Numista Deposit tokens: locker, shopping cart tokens

name: Trade token or good-for piece
definition: token issued by a merchant or private issuer to be exchanged for goods or a stated value.
notes: Numista Trade tokens and Business tokens

name: Wage, work or ration token
definition: token issued to workers as wages or work tally, or as a ration entitlement.
notes: Numista Work encampment, mine and wage tokens; Ration tokens

name: Tax token
definition: token issued to pay sales tax or another tax in fractions of the smallest coin.
notes: Numista lists Tax tokens and Sales tax tokens

name: Emergency money and scrip
definition: paper or other money issued to circulate as money by a non-currency issuer (F-16).
notes: Numista Emergency banknotes and Trade vouchers; scrip by non-currency issuers

name: Definitive stamp
definition: everyday postage stamp of an ongoing series with no specific subject or issue code.
notes: IOM glossary: Definitive Booklets and Variable Value Definitives

name: Commemorative or special-issue stamp [特殊切手]
definition: postage stamp issued for a limited period to mark an event, subject or season.
notes: USPS catalog: 91 commemorative stamps issued in 2025

name: Miniature or souvenir sheet
definition: small sheet issued as a unit with one or more stamps and a decorated margin.
notes: IOM glossary: Miniature Sheet, single stamp or set with decorative borders

name: Stamp booklet
definition: folded booklet of stamps issued by a postal administration as one unit.
notes: USPS Forever booklets of 20; IOM Definitive and Prestige Booklets

name: Stamped envelope
definition: envelope with a printed stamp issued by a postal administration.
notes: Wikipedia postal stationery lists stamped envelope; Sri Lanka Post sells stamped envelopes

name: Postal card with printed stamp
definition: postcard with a printed stamp issued by a postal administration.
notes: Sri Lanka Post sells Post Cards Stamped; Wikipedia postal card with imprinted stamp

name: First-day cover
definition: cover issued by a postal administration or prepared as a first-day cover, carrying stamps cancelled on their day of issue (K-118).
notes: IOM glossary First Day Cover; USPS Digital Color Postmark First Day Covers

name: Revenue stamp
definition: stamp issued to show payment of a tax or fee rather than postage.
notes: Wikipedia revenue stamp: label showing tax or fee paid; Sri Lanka Post sells revenue stamps
